source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 6.2 cu ft Direct Drive Top Load Washer

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic and clear codes
steps.body: Activate Service Diagnostic mode. Retrieve and clear fault codes. F7E3–F7E9 suggest motor/shifter path.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Activate Service Diagnostic mode. Retrieve and clear fault codes. F7E3–F7E9 suggest motor/shifter path.

steps.title: Fast Agitate runs 15–20 sec
steps.body: Enter Service Test Mode. Run Fast Agitate. Does motor run after 15–20 seconds?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Service Test Mode. Run Fast Agitate. Does motor run after 15–20 seconds?

steps.title: Spin test completes
steps.body: In Service Test Mode, command spin. If motor hums briefly then stops, check fault code display.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Service Test Mode, command spin. If motor hums briefly then stops, check fault code display.

steps.title: Continue to shifter or motor test
steps.body: If shifter-related (F7E5) or mechanical bind — run TEST #3a Shifter. For motor circuit faults (F7E2–F7E9, F1E2) — run TEST #3b Motor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: If shifter-related (F7E5) or mechanical bind — run TEST #3a Shifter. For motor circuit faults (F7E2–F7E9, F1E2) — run TEST #3b Motor.

steps.title: Drive system OK
steps.oemOutcome: Fast Agitate and spin pass in Service Test Mode — no further drive diagnosis needed.

steps.title: Run TEST #3a or #3b
steps.oemOutcome: Proceed to w10864849-test-03a-shifter or w10864849-test-03b-motor per fault code.
